title: autotune: default batching/caching heuristics, quantization profiles, and unit-econ tooling
author: Priya Kapoor
release_notes: Adds automated defaults for batching and KV caching, heuristics-based quantization profiles, and a unit-economics CLI/reporting pipeline. Backwards-compatible feature-flag rollout; observable impact: ~18-26% token cost reduction on mixed chat workloads in canary tests.
description: Motivation: reduce per-token unit economics without manual tuning by surfacing safe defaults and short-loop tooling. This PR adds three coordinated pieces: (1) default batching and KV-caching heuristics that adapt to model family, sequence-length distribution, and latency SLOs; (2) model-aware quantization profile recommendations and lightweight runtime hooks to apply profiles at serving time; (3) a unit-economics CLI and console integration that computes estimated cost/savings per route and surfaces guidance. Changes are feature-flag guarded and rolled out behind canaries. Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-4123) [x] unit tests for heuristics [x] integration test canary run [x] console metric hooks [x] docs update. Impact summary: default heuristics aim to reduce average cost per token by ~18% for chat workloads and up to ~26% on embedding-heavy workloads depending on model and sequence length distribution. Rollout plan: enable feature flag on 10% canary for low-traffic customers for 48h, validate latency/regression metrics, then incrementally increase. If unit-econ regressions >5% or P99 latency regressions >10%, auto-disable flag and alert SRE. The description below includes commits, changed files, review comments, and CI notes.
